exclusions: Only explicitly marked rules in the declared files are inventoried; unmarked prose and other files are outside this pilot.
Live provider configuration, repository protection settings and independent deployment evidence are not inspected by this audit.

rules.why: Writing quality requires contextual judgment, not a word-count gate.
Exact artifact hashes reject stale evidence.
rules.enforcement_scope: Calls to the completion checker and the repository test wrapper.
gaps: Adequate test scope and a trusted runner remain required.
Unwired completion paths are not guarded; runtime activation is not established by this inventory.

rules.why: Identity matching and conservative status checks reject uncertain retries.
rules.enforcement_scope: Calls to the operation decision helper.
gaps: Fresh authoritative status and atomic dispatch are adapter responsibilities.
Other retry paths and live adapter wiring are unverified.

rules.why: Metadata preflight applies explicit root and byte limits.
rules.enforcement_scope: Read requests explicitly routed through guard-read.
gaps: Alternate tools, filesystem races, startup failures and timeouts need independent controls.

rules.why: Promotion is a reviewed procedure; no deterministic approval gate is implemented.
rules.enforcement_scope: Future controls over installation and promotion decisions.
gaps: The procedure can currently be skipped by a caller.
No automatic promotion or hook installation is authorized by this registry.
